summary: A POLICY published beside the kit, opt-in: a host that takes it records a change only with a Conventional Commits 1.0.0 message. Its one rule keeps the `message-rules` contract and carries its own calibration (a free-form subject it must refuse, a conventional one it must admit), proven by `check` (FF-MESSAGE-RULE) before the commit-message hook a version-control adapter serves applies it.
